metaDescription: Order custom 6 oz hot cold packs for employee wellness or event giveaways. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 6 oz hot cold packs offer a compact, portable solution for treating minor aches and pains. Smaller than standard 12 oz packs, these fit easily into first aid kits, gym bags, or desk drawers, making them ideal for safety managers stocking break rooms or HR directors assembling wellness kits. Their size also reduces shipping weight for bulk orders. Choose from hot or cold activation options and imprint your logo directly on the pack for year-round brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom 6 oz hot cold packs with logo imprint, compact size for first aid kits and employee wellness programs
